title: Homebridge Accessory Response Time Leaderboard
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homebridge:accessory response_ms=*
| stats sum(response_ms) as total_value, avg(response_ms) as avg_value by accessory_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks accessory values by total and average response time across Homebridge accessory events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `response_ms` values for each Homebridge accessory event and review total and average response time by accessory.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total response time.
grandmaExplanation: It always which accessory shows the biggest response time numbers in your Homebridge accessory data.
